name: Gemma 4 12B Unified (instruction-tuned)
purpose: General-purpose reasoning, coding, agentic workflows and multimodal understanding for consumer GPUs and local deployment.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Gemma 4 repos carry no LICENSE file; the card links ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license, which redirects to gemma.ai/resources/apache-2/ (Google DeepMind, read through a summarizer 2026-11-19): plain Apache License 2.0 text ('perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable' grant), no Gemma-specific terms and no prohibited-use policy. The older Gemma Terms of Use (Gemma 1-3, TranslateGemma) are a different, restrictive text.

architecture.attention: sliding window 1024 interleaved with global layers (last global)
architecture.drafter: MTP file in the GGUF repo (mtp-gemma-4-12b-it.gguf, 0.47 GB)
architecture.why_this_design: Card: the 'Unified' 12B is encoder-free: it projects raw image patches and audio waveforms directly into the LLM embedding space through lightweight linear layers so that all modalities flow through one model. Card: hybrid attention interleaves local sliding-window with full global attention (final layer always global) to 'deliver the processing speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing the deep awareness required for complex, long-context tasks'.

engine_support.notes: No Gemma 4 module in Tona (ArchId list: Qwen4Exp, Qwen35Moe, NemotronHMoe).

strengths: Audio input (30 s clips) and video (60 s) in a 12B dense model that fits 12 GB at Q4-Q6
Official QAT GGUF; MMMLU 83.4 and GPQA 78.8 at this size (vendor)
weaknesses: Same Gemma 4 tool-call template problems as its siblings (reports on the 12B discussion board exist, content not read)
best_for: 12 GB cards: multilingual chat, voice and image questions

user_reports.summary: Single-operator measurement on one RTX 5070 Ti with llama.cpp: MTP depth 6 on QAT Q4_0 raises 12B decode from 89 to 226 tok/s at -0.83 points macro quality, but about 45 percent of completions differ textually from normal decoding (112/200 byte-identical).

tona_fit.reason: Best published all-round 12 GB-class model with audio input, Apache-2.0 (text read), and the German scores of the independent PeerBench index are ahead of Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3 14B in the same index (GermEval 79.6 vs 72.6 and 73.0, MuSR 81.6 vs 80.9 and 69.7; MMLU-ProX DE 73.1 vs 73.4 and 64.1). Missing Tona module is only a blocker.
